description: This JavaScript source file defines a LightningJS component called 'NotesList' that manages and displays a list of notes. It includes logic for rendering the UI, handling user interactions such as searching, creating, and navigating notes, and interacting with an external NoteService for data operations.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A Lightning component that displays a list of notes with features such as search, create, and navigation.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest notes from NoteService and updates the component's items and view.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query and updates focus and selection accordingly.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures that the onSelect callback is called for the currently focused item.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Public method to update the search query and re-filter notes.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and content, then updates the list and invokes the onCreate callback.

methods.name: focusNext
methods.description: Moves focus to the next note in the list.

methods.name: focusPrev
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous note in the list.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Determines row background color based on whether the note is selected.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Determines row opacity based on whether the note is selected.

methods.name: $time
methods.description: Formats ISO date string into a user-friendly 'Edited' timestamp.
